gates.merge: bin/workflow-stamp --check && bin/version-check --check && bin/quiet --label merge-gate --jobs auto -- python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q

goal.outcome: Release and roll out a lean Common Rules workflow that removes repeated ceremony while preserving evidence and safety.
constraints: The ledger remains authoritative and sponsor words are never discarded.
Full gates, independent review and release evidence remain mandatory at their actual boundaries.
Adopting repositories keep independent commits and existing uncommitted work.
verification: Verify requirements LR-01 through LR-07 with focused regression tests and an independent restricted-risk review.
Pass traceability, workspace coherence and the full release gate before publication.
Record rollout receipts from Bean Integration, Pockets UI and EisKaffee UI.
